# Draft:The Sword and The Shattered Timeline

----
The Sword and the Shattered Timeline is a young adult fantasy novel by Welsh author Chesney Jennings. The novel incorporates elements of Arthurian legend, Welsh mythology, and time travel, and is set partly in contemporary Wales. It is the first book in a planned series titled The Shattered Timeline Saga.
The novel was self-published in the United Kingdom and is available in paperback, ebook, and audiobook formats.
Plot
The story follows Dylan Hughes, a teenage boy living in a small Welsh town. After discovering an old sword hilt in his family home, Dylan becomes aware that King Arthur—traditionally central to British legend—has been erased from collective memory.
Alongside his friends Mahi and Lloyd, Dylan is drawn through a rupture in time into a fractured version of the past. There, they encounter Merlin, who reveals that Morgana has escaped imprisonment and shattered Excalibur, disrupting the timeline and removing Arthur from history.
The group embarks on a journey to recover the fragments of the sword in an effort to restore the timeline and prevent further instability. Their quest brings them into contact with figures and settings drawn from Arthurian and Celtic traditions.
Characters
* Dylan Hughes – The protagonist whose discovery of the sword hilt initiates the events of the novel.
* Mahi – One of Dylan’s closest friends, characterised by practicality and quick thinking.
* Lloyd – A loyal and protective member of the group.
* Merlin – A figure from Arthurian legend who guides the protagonists within the fractured timeline.
* Morgana – The antagonist whose actions cause the disruption of history.
* King Arthur – A legendary ruler whose erasure from history forms a central element of the plot.
Themes and influences
The novel draws heavily on Arthurian legend and Welsh mythology. Time travel is used as a narrative device to explore themes of memory, historical legacy, identity, and the consequences of altering the past. The setting combines modern Welsh locations with mythological landscapes.
Background
According to the author, the novel was influenced by Welsh folklore and traditional Arthurian narratives. Real locations in Wales are incorporated into the story alongside fictional and mythological elements.
Publication and distribution
The Sword and the Shattered Timeline was self-published and distributed through online retailers. The ebook edition has been made available through subscription-based digital reading platforms. An audiobook edition has also been released.
Reception
As of publication, discussion of the novel has primarily consisted of reader reviews on online retail and book-review platforms. Independent critical reviews from established literary publications have not been widely documented.
Series
The novel is the first instalment in The Shattered Timeline Saga. A sequel titled The Cauldron and the Red Wake has been announced by the author.
